entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Broken link to design-proposal issue template in contributing.md #65617
  • Better errors for Blazor asset integrity problems #65612
    Backlog
  • enum get represented as int in openapi generation #65610
  • ApiDescription server should inject Environment variable #65618
  • Consolidate `HttpsConnectionAdapterOptions` and `TlsHandshakeCallbackOptions` #65607
  • Investigate MVC view buffering subsystem changes to support UTF-8 HTML literal bytes end-to-end #65605
  • OpenAPI: OpenApiSchemaReference in properties throws InvalidOperationException #65600
  • Local reverse proxy is ineffective #65599

Closed

  • Some errors "Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)" appear in the browser console panel when updating the Counter file of 11.0 Blazor Web for WASM App and then run without build #65271
    .NET 11 Planning
  • ResourceCollectionProvider leaks an `IJSObjectReference`. #65596
    Backlog
  • Extraneous lines in new webapi project http file #65317

Created

  • Update CONTRIBUTING.md #65616
    area-infrastructure, community-contribution

    area-blazor, community-contribution

  • QuickGrid SSR support #65451
    area-blazor, pending-ci-rerun
